gloss: influential person; local boss; prominent figure

definitions.gloss: influential person; local boss; prominent figure
definitions.explanation: a person who holds power or influence in a community, organization, or industry, often through personal connections rather than official position

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はこの{町|まち}の{顔役|かおやく}だ。
examples.english: He's the big shot of this town.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{顔役|かおやく}に{挨拶|あいさつ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to pay my respects to the local bigwig.

examples.japanese: {業界|ぎょうかい}の{顔役|かおやく}として{知|し}られる{彼|かれ}は、{若|わか}い{経営者|けいえいしゃ}たちの{相談役|そうだんやく}でもある。
examples.english: Known as a prominent figure in the industry, he also serves as an advisor to young business owners.

notes:
Combines {顔|かお} (face) and {役|やく} (role). The word literally suggests someone whose face (identity, presence) carries weight. It can have positive connotations (respected community leader) or negative ones (local power broker, person with underworld connections), depending on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {地元|じもと}の{顔役|かおやく}: local boss; community leader
- {業界|ぎょうかい}の{顔役|かおやく}: industry heavyweight
- {顔役|かおやく}として{知|し}られる: known as a prominent figure
- {顔役|かおやく}を{務|つと}める: to serve as a leading figure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ボス: boss — a loanword with similar meaning but more casual
- {有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}: influential person — more formal and neutral, without the colorful connotation
- {実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: person of real power — emphasizes actual capability and influence behind the scenes
